verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a Create Campaign API and an official MCP server that external agents can use for campaign creation (e.g., "Create an email campaign promoting our Memorial Day sale"). Its Composer AI builds the audience, drafts content, plans the send strategy, and "build[s] marketing for your review… with you in control," which supports a draft-for-human-review workflow. However, the evidence never states that agent-created campaigns stay as unsent drafts or scheduled items awaiting approval, and segment targeting through the API/MCP is not shown. Missing for 10: explicit draft/scheduled/queued campaign state for agent-created campaigns, documented segment targeting via API/MCP, an explicit human approval gate before send, and hands-on corroboration.
